wizard.title: Start here — three connections that pay off fast
wizard.blurbPersonal: For personal use: mail + calendar (+ Instagram if you want DMs in one place).
wizard.blurbBusiness: For business: mail + Instagram (+ Shopify if you sell online).

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.whyPersonal: Get mail in Messages and AI drafts you approve before send.
gmail.whyBusiness: Triage customer mail (Today/Week) and reply with AI drafts.

google_calendar.title: Google Calendar
google_calendar.why: See today’s meetings on Home and in Calendar.

instagram.title: Instagram
instagram.whyPersonal: DMs and social inbox in one place.
instagram.whyBusiness: DM automations and social inbox for customer contact.

shopify.title: Shopify
shopify.why: Orders, stock and cart recovery under E-commerce.

firstWin.title: Get started — {{done}}/{{total}} done ({{percent}}%)
firstWin.subtitle: Connect, open the inbox, and enable a safe automation. You always approve before send.
firstWin.allDoneBody: Brief, Messages and Automations have data to work with. Check Home every morning.

connectMail.title: Connect mail
connectMail.detail: Gmail or Outlook — the first step to an inbox that actually helps.
connectMail.detailDone: You can triage and reply under Messages.

connectChannel.title: Connect another channel
connectChannel.detailPersonal: Calendar or Instagram gives you more than mail alone.
connectChannel.detailBusiness: Instagram or Shopify brings DMs and orders into one workspace.
connectChannel.detailDone: Social, calendar or store syncs into the app.

openInbox.title: Open Messages
openInbox.detail: See the Today bucket, AI drafts, and approve before anything is sent.

enableAutomation.title: Turn on an automation
enableAutomation.detail: E.g. AI drafts for DM or mail — draft-before-send where it matters.

fillCompany.title: Fill in Company
fillCompany.detail: Description and website make drafts and leads much better.
fillCompany.detailDone: AI and leads become more relevant.

boost.blurbPending: Fill in a few things — AI and automations become more useful right away.
